name: translation-review
description: translate.beekeeperstudio.io: translators review the machine-translated copies of beekeeperstudio.io and file their notes as GitHub issues.

scripts.preview: vite build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name translation-review
